Vulnerability_Finding: Unauthenticated root bindshell listening on TCP port 1524 via inetd (ingreslock)
Threat_Scenario: Any network-adjacent attacker connects to TCP/1524 and immediately obtains unauthenticated root shell access.
Root_Cause_Gap: No hardening baseline; No asset inventory
Remediation_Action: Commented out ingreslock/1524 in /etc/inetd.conf, reloaded openbsd-inetd, blocked port via iptables, and verified closure via health_check.sh.

Vulnerability_Finding: Backdoored vsftpd 2.3.4 service listening on TCP port 21
Threat_Scenario: Remote attacker triggers smiley-face backdoor payload to spawn a root shell on TCP port 6200.
Root_Cause_Gap: No patch management program; No hardening baseline
Remediation_Action: Terminated vsftpd process, removed FTP entry from /etc/inetd.conf, restarted inetd, and verified TCP/21 closure via health_check.sh.

Vulnerability_Finding: Legacy unencrypted remote-access daemons enabled (Telnet TCP/23 and rsh/rlogin/rexec TCP/512-514)
Threat_Scenario: Attacker sniffs cleartext administrative credentials on the network or exploits trust-based r-services for unauthorized access.
Root_Cause_Gap: No hardening baseline; No change management review
Remediation_Action: Disabled telnet and rsh-family services in /etc/inetd.conf, enforced SSH-only remote administration, and verified ports 23, 512-514 closed.

Vulnerability_Finding: Outdated Samba file-sharing service (Samba 3.0.20) exposed on TCP ports 139 and 445
Threat_Scenario: Remote attacker exploits username map script command injection to execute arbitrary commands as root.
Root_Cause_Gap: No patch management program; No asset inventory
Remediation_Action: Stopped Samba daemon, removed boot startup links via update-rc.d -f samba remove, and verified ports 139/445 closed.

Vulnerability_Finding: Exposed distributed compiler daemon (distccd) listening on TCP port 3632
Threat_Scenario: Unauthenticated remote attacker executes arbitrary shell commands via exposed distcc compilation requests.
Root_Cause_Gap: No hardening baseline; No change management review
Remediation_Action: Stopped distcc service, disabled boot persistence via update-rc.d -f distcc remove, and confirmed TCP/3632 closed.

Vulnerability_Finding: Backdoored UnrealIRCd service running on TCP ports 6667 and 6697 with boot persistence
Threat_Scenario: Remote attacker sends AB trigger string to execute arbitrary system commands with service privileges.
Root_Cause_Gap: No asset inventory; No patch management program
Remediation_Action: Terminated running process via pkill -f unrealircd, removed boot startup script via update-rc.d -f unrealircd remove, and verified ports 6667/6697 closed.
